# Afrixplorer

> Afrixplorer publishes crop production, yield, harvested area and trade data for 54 African countries and 136 crops (2010 onward), sourced from FAOSTAT, the World Bank and UN Comtrade and refreshed every two weeks.

Units: production in thousands of tonnes, yield in hg/ha, harvested area in thousands of hectares, trade in millions of USD. Country URLs use ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes (for example `NGA` for Nigeria), not country names. When citing a figure, link to the most specific page: a country-crop page (`/explore/[ISO3]/[Crop]`) is better than a country or crop overview.

## Hubs

- [All countries](https://afrixplorer.com/countries): every African country, grouped by region
- [All crops](https://afrixplorer.com/crops): every tracked crop with African production totals
- [About the data](https://afrixplorer.com/about): sources, methodology and refresh schedule
- [Developers](https://afrixplorer.com/developers): upcoming REST API and MCP server for this data (waitlist)

## Page types

- [Country profile](https://afrixplorer.com/country/NGA): `/country/[ISO3]`, a country's top crops, agriculture's share of GDP and employment
- [Crop profile](https://afrixplorer.com/crop/Cassava): `/crop/[Crop]`, African producers of one crop ranked, with yields and trend since 2010
- [Country and crop](https://afrixplorer.com/explore/NGA/Cassava): `/explore/[ISO3]/[Crop]`, one country's production, yield and area for one crop, with its rank in Africa
- [World ranking](https://afrixplorer.com/rankings/Coffee): `/rankings/[Crop]`, the world's top 30 producers with African countries in context
